_comment: decode-orc's own derivation rules for the videosynth suite, in the format of
projects/variants.json in the pinned videosynth source. The build runs that
source's scripts/generate_test_projects.py over this tree and writes the

variants.name: alignment-captures
variants.description: Captures of the alignment discs: whole; starting later (PN 5); replaying the multi-burst range (PNs 9-12); ending early (PN 12).

variants.name: pulldown-captures
variants.description: Captures of the pulldown film disc, each with its own capture seed: whole; starting later (reel 2, PN 9); replaying reel 3 (PNs 17-24); ending early (PN 24).

variants.name: pulldown-clean
variants.description: The pulldown film disc without its noise and dropouts: the truth its stacks are measured against.

variants.name: smoke-yc
variants.description: Y/C renderings of the smoke cases.

variants.name: smoke-clean
variants.description: The smoke and dropout cases with their impairment blocks removed: the truth each case is compared against.

variants.name: conceal-clean
variants.description: The dropout concealment cases with their dropouts removed: the truth each is compared against.

variants.name: conceal-yc
variants.description: Y/C renderings of the dropout concealment cases.

variants.name: conceal-yc-clean
variants.description: Y/C renderings of the dropout concealment cases with their dropouts removed: the Y/C truth.

variants.name: stacking-clean
variants.description: The reference stacking capture and the held stills with their impairment blocks removed: the truth the stacks are compared against.

variants.name: stacking-chroma
variants.description: More captures of capture A's disc, with fresh capture seeds: one by another player whose chroma is right, and two by players with a chroma gain of 0.85, one whose error is in the picture chroma only and one whose error reaches the burst too.

variants.name: domesday-captures
variants.description: Four captures of each Domesday-model pressing, each with its own capture seeds; pressing B offsets its seeds by 1000. Capture 3 reads one sample off the others, as Community South's DS4 does against the rest of its pressing; its pressing noise moves with the picture.

variants.name: pressing-defect-captures
variants.description: Four captures of Domesday-model pressing A with stamper defects, with the capture seeds of domesday-captures' pressing A: the same captures, with the pressing's unflagged dropouts on every one.

variants.name: domesday-clean
variants.description: Domesday-model pressing A with its noise removed: the truth its stacks are compared against.

variants.name: picture-band-captures
variants.description: Two captures of each picture-band pressing, each with its own capture seeds; pressing B offsets its seeds by 1000.

variants.name: picture-band-clean
variants.description: Picture-band pressing A with its noise removed: the truth the band limit is measured against.

variants.name: fm-beat-clean
variants.description: The FM-beat case with its noise removed: the beat alone on the picture. The build drops its channel block for the truth without the beat (CMakeLists.txt).

variants.name: decoders-yc
variants.description: Y/C renderings of the decoder patterns and the moving colour: the reference each decoder's composite decode is measured against.

variants.name: sources-yc
variants.description: Y/C renderings of the CLV source and noise cases.
